protocol_type: EtherCAT runs three nested protocols in one packet: (a) outer Ethernet frame (DA + SA + EtherType 0x88A4 + Payload + FCS), (b) EtherCAT header (Length + Reserved + Type=0x1), (c) one or more EtherCAT datagrams chained by the Next bit, each carrying its own Cmd / Idx / Address / Length / IRQ / Data / WKC.

channels.name: Ethernet wire — Port 1/2/3 (Downstream)
channels.description: On-the-fly forwarding to next SubDevice. Last port loops back.

channels.name: PDI (Process Data Interface)
channels.description: Async/sync µC bus, SPI, DIO, or on-chip CPU bus. Plus IRQ, SYNC0/SYNC1 DC outputs, LATCH0/LATCH1 DC inputs.

channels.name: SII (EEPROM Slave Information Interface)
channels.description: I²C-compatible 2-wire to serial EEPROM (1 Kbit-4 Mbit).

packet_classes.purpose: Default low-latency on-segment transport. DA unconstrained.
packet_classes.format: Preamble(7B) + SFD(1B) + DA(6B) + SA(6B) + EtherType=0x88A4(2B) + EtherCAT_Header(2B) + Datagram_block(60-1500B) + FCS(4B)

packet_classes.purpose: Cross-network routing through standard IP infrastructure.
packet_classes.format: Eth(EtherType=0x0800) + IP + UDP(dst=0x88A4) + EtherCAT_Header + Datagram_block + Eth_FCS

packet_classes.purpose: One unit of read/modify/write addressing inside the frame.
packet_classes.format: Cmd(1B) + Idx(1B) + Address(4B) + Length+Next(2B) + IRQ(2B) + Data(Length B) + Working_Counter(2B)

valid_ready_handshake_rules: MII TX path: TX_EN must be asserted synchronously with the first nibble of the preamble and remain asserted while all nibbles are presented. TX_EN must de-assert before the first TX_CLK after the final nibble.

MII RX path: RX_DV must remain asserted continuously from the first recovered nibble through the final recovered nibble, and de-assert before the first RX_CLK that follows the final nibble. RX_DV must encompass the frame starting no later than the SFD.
MII CRS: asserted whenever either TX or RX medium is non-idle; remains asserted throughout a collision condition. Need not be synchronous to TX_CLK or RX_CLK.
MII COL: asserted on collision detection (half-duplex only); behaviour is unspecified in full-duplex modes.
GMII: same handshake rules as MII, but on a byte-wide path at 125 MHz with GTX_CLK driven by the MAC.

MDIO Clause 22: STA drives PRE + ST + OP + PHYAD + REGAD; on a Read, both sides go high-Z during the first TA bit and the PHY drives a 0 during the second TA bit before driving 16 data bits MSB first. On a Write, STA drives 10 during TA then 16 data bits.
MDIO Clause 45: each transaction is two consecutive 64-bit cycles — an Address cycle (OP=00) writes the 16-bit indirect address, then a Data cycle (OP=01 / 11 / 10) accesses the selected register.
PAUSE frame: receiver checks DA = 01:80:C2:00:00:01 and EtherType = 0x8808 and opcode = 0x0001 before entering the paused state for the indicated number of pause quanta (1 quantum = 512 bit times).

frame_format.mac_data_frame: Preamble(7×0x55) + SFD(0xD5) + DA(6 B) + SA(6 B) + Type/Length(2 B) + Payload(46-1500 B) + Pad(0-46 B) + FCS(4 B CRC-32).
frame_format.vlan_tagged_frame: Preamble + SFD + DA(6 B) + SA(6 B) + TPID(0x8100, 2 B) + TCI(2 B = PCP[3] + DEI[1] + VID[12]) + EtherType/Length(2 B) + Payload + FCS — max 1522 B.
frame_format.pause_frame: DA = 01:80:C2:00:00:01, EtherType = 0x8808, MAC Control Opcode = 0x0001, Pause Quanta (16 b), pad to 64 B, FCS.
frame_format.mdio_c22_frame: PRE(32) + ST(01) + OP(10/01) + PHYAD(5) + REGAD(5) + TA(2) + DATA(16) — total 64 MDC cycles (32 PRE + 32 frame).
frame_format.mdio_c45_address: PRE(32) + ST(00) + OP(00) + PRTAD(5) + DEVAD(5) + TA(10) + ADDR(16) — 64 MDC cycles.
frame_format.mdio_c45_data: PRE(32) + ST(00) + OP(01/11/10) + PRTAD(5) + DEVAD(5) + TA + DATA(16) — 64 MDC cycles, must follow an Address cycle on the same DEVAD.

fields.name: Length
fields.description: Total length of following datagrams in bytes.

fields.name: Address
fields.description: Cmd-dependent: AP→Position+Offset, FP→ConfigStaAddr+Offset, BC→0+Offset, LOG→32-bit Logical.

datagram_tail.description: After the Data field, every datagram ends with a 16-bit Working Counter (WKC) updated by each addressed SubDevice.

commands_table.name: APRD
commands_table.wkc_increment_rule: +1 by SubDevice whose Position == 0 after increment.
commands_table.typical_use: Start-up sweep before Configured Station Address.

commands_table.name: APWR
commands_table.wkc_increment_rule: +1 by SubDevice whose Position == 0 after increment.

commands_table.name: FPRD
commands_table.wkc_increment_rule: +1 by SubDevice whose Configured Station Address matches.
commands_table.typical_use: Targeted read of one specific SubDevice.

commands_table.name: FPWR
commands_table.typical_use: Targeted register write — AL Control, SM, FMMU.

commands_table.name: BRD
commands_table.typical_use: Cyclic status sweep (e.g. AL Status of every SubDevice).

commands_table.name: LRD
commands_table.wkc_increment_rule: +1 by every SubDevice whose Read-Type FMMU maps the bits.

commands_table.name: LWR
commands_table.wkc_increment_rule: +1 by every SubDevice whose Write-Type FMMU maps.

commands_table.name: LRW
commands_table.typical_use: Combined process-data IO (most common cyclic command).

commands_table.name: ARMW
commands_table.wkc_increment_rule: +1 by first matching SubDevice; downstream SubDevices read.

commands_table.name: FRMW
commands_table.wkc_increment_rule: +1 by FP-matching SubDevice; downstream SubDevices copy.
commands_table.typical_use: Re-distribute value from one FP-addressed SubDevice.

addressing_modes.name: Position (AP)
addressing_modes.address_high_word_meaning: Signed 16-bit position; incremented at each SubDevice; match @ 0x0000.

addressing_modes.name: Logical (LOG)
addressing_modes.address_high_word_meaning: Part of 32-bit network-wide Logical Address space.

esm_state_transitions.trigger: AL Control = 0x04 OR PD WD expiry

mailbox_protocols_on_sm.name: EoE
mailbox_protocols_on_sm.description: Tunnels 802.3 frames for IP apps on SubDevice.

mailbox_protocols_on_sm.name: FoE
mailbox_protocols_on_sm.description: TFTP-like firmware download in Boot state.

mailbox_protocols_on_sm.description: Beckhoff routed messaging (AMS Net Id + Port).
